take: Vegas announced it activated defenseman Parker Wotherspoon from injured reserve, ending a five-game absence. The Golden Knights have gone 12-5-2 and controlled 54.5% of expected goals (a measure of chance quality) on the season. Wotherspoon averages 18:16 a night on the second pair and kills penalties, and VGK have held 55.75% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on the ice. Without him, Rasmus Andersson climbed to 21:02 a night and Brayden McNabb to 21:04. Those two should get some of that time back, and Jeremy Lauzon, who moved in beside Andersson, may see his role shrink.
